help.short: The name of the security alert policy.

description: Get a server's security alert policy.

operations.description: Get a server's security alert policy.

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The name of the security alert policy.
params.name: securityAlertPolicyName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: Specifies an array of alerts that are disabled. Allowed values are: Sql_Injection, Sql_Injection_Vulnerability, Access_Anomaly
props.name: disabledAlerts

props.description: Specifies that the alert is sent to the account administrators.
props.name: emailAccountAdmins

props.description: Specifies an array of e-mail addresses to which the alert is sent.
props.name: emailAddresses

props.description: Specifies the number of days to keep in the Threat Detection audit logs.
props.name: retentionDays

props.description: Specifies the state of the policy, whether it is enabled or disabled.
props.name: state

props.description: Specifies the identifier key of the Threat Detection audit storage account.
props.name: storageAccountAccessKey

props.description: Specifies the blob storage endpoint (e.g. https://MyAccount.blob.core.windows.net). This blob storage will hold all Threat Detection audit logs.
props.name: storageEndpoint

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type

responses.description: Successfully retrieved the server threat detection policy.
Error response describing why the operation of getting security alert policies failed.
